name: Fenugreek
summary: Bittersweet seeds with a distinctive maple-like aroma. Essential in Ethiopian berbere, Indian dal tadka, and many pickles and spice blends.
description: Fenugreek seeds are hard, angular, and yellow-ochre in colour. Raw, they are intensely bitter — but brief dry-toasting mellows them into a warm, nutty depth with subtle maple undertones. The leaves (methi) are a separate product with a lighter, more herbal character. Fenugreek is prized in Ethiopian, South Indian, and North African cooking as a grounding note in complex spice blends. Use sparingly — too much dominates a dish.
